name: Lilly Bernstein
original_name: リリー＝バーンスタイン
source:
[i]"I'm not as unfortunate as everyone believes. Because he's always here... in my heart."[/i]

The young daughter of the House Bernstein, and Edward's sister. A beautiful, refined and modest woman, nicknamed "Madonna Lily" in high society.

She spends her days wondering how she can end the friction that exists between her father Edmund and her brother Edward. She ran away with her beloved and eloped, but after his death, she returned to her family's home.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/lilly/]Aksys Games[/url]]
